facts.value: Students can earn a second degree from a leading international business school under this ‘dual degree’ pathway.
First two years studying in Limerick and last two years studying at another Business School.
Students retain the benefits of UL arranged work placement.
The six partner institutions are located in France, Germany, Poland, and Japan.
Upon successful completion, students will receive both UL’s Bachelor of Business Studies degree and an equivalent degree from the other business school.
